message.content:
This is a suspension-related part for motor vehicles. Heading 8708 covers parts and accessories of motor vehicles, and 8708.80 covers suspension systems and parts thereof, including shock absorbers. Within 8708.80, subheading 8708.80.65 covers other suspension systems and parts, and its statistical suffixes are 8708.80.6590 for parts and 8708.80.6560 for others. The exact suffix is from memory, so I am less sure of it.

The 8708.80 structure as I recall it:
- 8708.80.1000 – MacPherson struts
- 8708.80.6530 – Other: for vehicles of heading 8701 (tractors)
- 8708.80.6590 – Other: other

A customs ruling on a "pull bar" from CBP likely classified it under 8708.80.6590. A pull bar is also a torque or suspension link, which fits the same subheading. Because race cars are still motor vehicles of heading 8703, I chose 8708.80.6590.

{"hts_code": "8708.80.6590", "reason": "Pull bars/torque absorbers are designed exclusively for installation in motor vehicle suspension systems, making them suspension system parts under heading 8708, subheading 8708.80."}
